site.description: I am VeguiDev, a software developer who can create a website for your business, a service for your employees, or a mod for your Minecraft server.

discord.aboutContent: Hi, I'm Juan Manuel, known as VeguiDev, a passionate 19-year-old software developer determined to boost your business by building the solutions you need.
discord.inputSubtext: Press enter to send the message

info.title: Information
info.content: I am Juan Manuel Menta, a software developer with experience in web development, cross-platform desktop applications, and Minecraft server modding. I can design a professional website for your business, create internal tools to optimize your employees' workflow, or develop mods and plugins to enhance the experience on your Minecraft server.

formation.title: Education
formation.content: I am a Multimedia Technician, graduated from the San Antonio de Padua Institute, where I gained a solid foundation in audiovisual communication, design, and technology. Currently, I continue my academic training by pursuing a degree in Information Systems Management at UADE.

projects.title: Projects
projects.content: I have worked on a wide range of projects, from creating websites and desktop applications to developing mods and plugins for Minecraft servers. If you are looking for a software developer with experience and passion for their work, you are in the right place!

skills.title: Skills
skills.content: All the technologies and tools I use in my projects with a description of each one. From programming languages to frameworks and libraries.
